data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Cecilia, which means 'blind' or 'hidden'. In Christian tradition, Saint Cecilia is the patron saint of music and musicians, and her name is often given to those who love music and art. The name Cilka carries the meaning “Diminutive of Cecilia” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cilka usually hope their child will grow to embody diminutive of cecilia and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Cilka, derived from the Latin Cecilia, has rich cultural significance. It carries the associations of the fourth-century saint, who chose to pursue her love for music during her marriage to the Roman Valerian, despite temptations to abandon her faith. The name Cilka honors this ancient woman's unwavering dedication to music and artistic expression.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Cilka acknowledges the hidden depths and outstanding ability given by God to each individual. Through the name, we are reminded of Cecilia's unwavering faith, steadfastness, and deep love for music, which inspire us in our spiritual journeys. Cilka's name is a testament to the power of the divine in everyday life, urging us to believe in the mysterious and beautiful ways God works in our lives.
